turns.text: What is X-HIP ID / X-HIU-ID / X-CM-ID and how to generate them?

must_contain: X-HIP-ID is obtained by registering as a HIP service after HFR registration
X-HIU-ID is obtained by registering as a HIU service after HFR registration
X-CM-ID identifies the HIE-CM, and for the sandbox its value is sbx
